newsitem.title: JAPAN: No damage or casualties from Japan undersea quake.
newsitem.headline: No damage or casualties from Japan undersea quake.

text.p: An earthquake struck under the sea off Japan on Thursday morning, but there were no reports of casualties or damage, Japan's Meteorological Agency said.
A spokesman for the agency said the epicentre of the quake, which measured 5.8 on the Richter scale, was 19 km (12 miles) under the sea about 1,000 km (625 miles) south of Tokyo.
"There were no casualties or damage," the spokesman said.
The quake happened at 5.01 a.m. (2001 GMT Wednesday).
